tagline: STIHL and outdoor power equipment for New Plymouth
heroSubheading: We stock, service and support everything you need for outdoor work and property care.
aboutHtml:
Hamish and Kate Scott opened STIHL SHOP New Plymouth in 2018. We specialise in selling and servicing outdoor power equipment, with expert advice for every project. Whether you're after a new STIHL chainsaw, a ride on mower, or parts and service for what you already own, we've got you covered.

We're Taranaki's ride on mower specialist, with a large workshop ready to service most makes and models. We stock STIHL, Masport, Cub Cadet, Rover, Stiga and Hustler ride ons, Hansa Chippers, Silky Saws, and Ziegler and Brown BBQs. You can also order our STIHL range online and pick up in store or have it delivered.

Come in and see us. We're open Monday to Friday 8am to 5pm, Saturday and Sunday 9am to 3pm.
